title: Salesforce Uses Momentum Deal To Turn Calls Into CRM Value Question
title_zh: Salesforce 利用 Momentum Deal 将来电转化为 CRM 价值问题
summary: Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) has acquired conversational AI platform Momentum to feed voice and video data into Agentforce 360 and Slackbot.
summary_zh: Salesforce（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）已收购对话式人工智能平台 Momentum，将语音和视频数据输入 Agentforce 360​​ 和 Slackbot。

title: Alphabet Energy Deals Shape Long Term AI Data Center Outlook
title_zh: Alphabet Energy 交易塑造人工智能数据中心的长期前景
summary: Alphabet, parent of Google (NasdaqGS:GOOGL), has entered into major energy deals with Xcel Energy in Minnesota and AES Corporation in Texas to supply new data centers with large-scale clean power.
summary_zh: 谷歌（NasdaqGS：GOOGL）的母公司 Alphabet 已与明尼苏达州的 Xcel Energy 和德克萨斯州的 AES Corporation 达成重大能源交易，为新数据中心提供大规模清洁电力。

title: Bank of America resets AMD stock price target on deal with Meta
title_zh: 美国银行因与 Meta 的交易而重置 AMD 股价目标
summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) stock has lost about 18% in the past month, at the time of writing, Wednesday afternoon, Feb. 25, according to Yahoo Finance. Meanwhile, the SPDR S&P 500 index (SPY) is up about 0.4% in the same period.
summary_zh: 据雅虎财经报道，截至本文撰写之时，即 2 月 25 日星期三下午，AMD 股价在过去一个月内下跌了约 18%。与此同时，SPDR S&P 500 指数 (SPY) 同期上涨约 0.4%。

title: Quantum Computing Stocks: IonQ Earnings, Revenue Beat Amid Acquisitions
title_zh: 量子计算股票：IonQ 盈利、收入因收购而增长
summary: Kicking off earnings reports for quantum computing stocks, IonQ reported Q4 profit and revenue that topped views amid an acquisition spree.
summary_zh: IonQ 在发布量子计算股票收益报告时公布了第四季度的利润和收入，在收购热潮中表现出色。

title: Market Chatter: Kuwait Petroleum Held Talks With Investors Over Potential $7 Billion Pipeline Deal
title_zh: 市场热议：科威特石油公司与投资者就潜在的 70 亿美元管道交易进行会谈
summary: Kuwait Petroleum had early talks with investors like BlackRock (BLK), KKR (KKR), EIG Partners, and B
summary_zh: 科威特石油公司与 BlackRock (BLK)、KKR (KKR)、EIG Partners 和 B 等投资者进行了早期谈判
